title: 代码注释
problem_statement_md:
给定代码包括几行注释过的代码。

请取消注释部分代码，输出"Java很好"
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Java Comments [/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given lines of commented code. Uncomment the required lines in order to have a "Java is awesome" output.

[note]Be careful not to uncomment extra lines.[/note]
hint_md: 请注意不要取消注释多余的行。
